## 15201 - 15213

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15201">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15201 Source apply conversion not possible (heating value condition)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15201">

This validation and exception applies on sample apply from a GQ Source to gas meter data. This exception will be generated if:

- The Heating Value Saturation on the GQ Source Assignment is set to Meter Condition, but neither the Heating Value Saturation on the Meter Analysis or the EFM Heat Value Condition for GPA 2172 is set on the Meter.
- The Heating Value Saturation on the GQ Source Assignment is set to As Delivered, but the BTU Base on the Sample that FLOWCAL is attempting to apply is a value other than As Delivered (Wet, Dry, etc.).

 

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15202">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15202 Source apply conversion not possible (pressure base)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15202">

**For Gas Meter Data or Gas Loss Tickets:** If a sample that FLOWCAL is attempting to apply to a record has a Pressure Base less than or equal to 0, or is empty, then the sample will not apply and this exception will be generated.

**For Liquid Meter Data or Tickets:** If the sample apply is configured to apply density and the sample that FLOWCAL is attempting to apply to a record has a Pressure Base less than or equal to 0, or is empty, then the sample will not apply and this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15203">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15203 Source apply conversion not possible (heating value)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15203">

This validation and exception applies on sample apply from a GQ Source to gas meter data or a gas loss ticket.

If a sample that FLOWCAL is attempting to apply to gas meter data or a gas loss ticket has a Heating Value less than or equal to 0, or is empty, then the sample will not apply and this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15204">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15204 Source apply not possible (products do not match)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15204">

This validation and exception applies on sample apply from a GQ Source to gas meter data or a gas loss ticket.

If a sample that FLOWCAL is attempting to apply has a Product defined, FLOWCAL will validate that the sample and record have the same Product before applying the sample. If the Products are different, then the sample will not apply and this exception will be generated.

For example, if the sample has a Product of “Propane”, but the ticket that FLOWCAL is attempting to apply the sample to has a Product of “Ethane”, then the sample will not apply and this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15205">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15205 Source apply not possible (temperature base)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15205">

For Gas Meter Data or Gas Loss Tickets: If a sample that FLOWCAL is attempting to apply to a record has a Temperature Base less than or equal to 0, or is empty, then the sample will not apply and this exception will be generated.

For Liquid Meter Data or Tickets: If the sample apply is configured to apply density and the sample that FLOWCAL is attempting to apply to a record has a Temperature Base less than or equal to 0, or is empty, then the sample will not apply and this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15206">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15206 Source apply not possible (unit set discrepancy)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15206">

**For Gas Meter Data or Gas Loss Tickets:** FLOWCAL will compare the Pressure Base Unit and Temperature Base Unit on the sample to the Pressure Base Unit and Temperature Base Unit on the record. If either of the unit values is different, then the sample will not apply and this exception will be generated.

**For Liquid Meter Data or Tickets:** If the sample apply is configured to apply density, FLOWCAL will compare the Pressure Base, Pressure Base Unit, Temperature Base, and Temperature Base Unit on the sample to the Pressure Base, Pressure Base Unit, Temperature Base, and Temperature Base Unit on the record. If any of the values are different, then the sample will not apply and this exception will be generated.

The units for Tickets will be pulled from the System units for the System that the Location on the Ticket is a member of. If the Gas Loss Ticket does not have a Location set, then the units will be pulled from the System units for the Default System.

FLOWCAL currently supports the following units for US and SI units for the temperature and pressure base:

- US Units:
  - Pressure Base: PSIA
  - Temperature Base: Fahrenheit
- SI Units:
  - Pressure Base: Kilopascal and Bar
  - Temperature Base: Celsius

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15207">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15207 Density values not copied to meter analysis (unit set discrepancy); only sample percentages copied</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15207">

This exception is generated when there's a discrepancy between sample unit and liquid meter/ticket data unit.

For example, if the pressure base unit in the sample is psi, and temperature base unit is Fahrenheit, but the meter has kilopascal and Celsius, respectively, then this exception will be generated when attempting to apply the sample.

</div>

#### 15208 Measured HV not pressure base adjusted (unit set discrepancy) (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15209">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15209 Source calculation not possible (unit set discrepancy)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15209">

This validation and exception applies on Gas Meter data for meters that have the Quality Calculations enabled on the Calculations \> Quality sub-tab in the Meter Editor.

When attempting to perform a quality calculation on meter analysis data, FLOWCAL will compare the units for Pressure Base, Temperature Base, Heating Value, and Mass Heating Value on the meter characteristic to the units on the HC Properties tied to that meter. If any of the unit values differ, then quality calculations will not be performed and this exception will be generated.

For gas meters configured to use GQ Calc at the meter level. FLOWCAL will compare units for Pressure Base, Temperature Base, HV, and Mass HV. If any differ, this exception should be generated.

FLOWCAL currently supports the following units for US and SI units for the mentioned data points:

- US Units:
  - Pressure Base: PSIA
  - Temperature Base: Fahrenheit
  - Heating Value: BTU/scf
  - Mass Heating Value: BTU/Lbm
- SI Units:
  - Pressure Base: Kilopascal
  - Temperature Base: Celsius
  - Heating Value: MegaJoule/Cubic Meter
  - Mass Heating Value: MegaJoule/Kg

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15210">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15210 Source apply - Density selected by user not applied; fallback density used</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15210">

This validation and exception applies on sample apply from a LQ Source or Standalone Sample to liquid meter data or a ticket.

If the sample apply is configured to apply density, but the density chosen to apply is not found on the sample, then FLOWCAL will use the next available density on the sample and this exception will be generated.

For example, a sample has a value provided for Relative Density, but not API Gravity. The sample is configured to apply to a ticket with the Apply Density Option set to API Gravity. Since API Gravity is not available on the sample, FLOWCAL will fail over to applying the Relative Density from the sample and generate this exception.

The density apply will fail over to using a sample density value in the order depicted in the table below.

| Apply Density Option | 1st Failover     | 2nd Failover     |
|:---------------------|:-----------------|:-----------------|
| Relative Density     | API Gravity      | Absolute Density |
| API Gravity          | Relative Density | Absolute Density |
| Absolute Density     | Relative Density | API Gravity      |

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15211">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15211 Source apply - Fallback density not applied</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15211">

This validation and exception applies on sample apply from a LQ Source or Standalone Sample to liquid meter data or a ticket.

If the sample apply is configured to apply density, but no density values are found on the sample, then FLOWCAL will not apply a density from the sample and this exception will be generated.

For example, a sample has no value provided for Relative Density, API Gravity, or Absolute Density. The sample is configured to apply to a ticket with the Apply Density Option set to API Gravity. Since API Gravity is not available on the sample, FLOWCAL will attempt to fail over to applying the Relative Density or Absolute Density from the sample. Since values are not available for these densities on the sample either, FLOWCAL will not apply a density from the sample and this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15212">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15212 Source Apply conversion not possible (standard heating value)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15212">

If Flowing Gas Condition is left blank on the GPA 2172 tab in the Volume Editor, FLOWCAL will calculate a standard heating value using a conversion factor to account for going from one heating value condition on the meter such as Dry to a different heating value condition at the system level such as Wet when applying an assigned source. When FLOWCAL attempts to apply the assigned source to the gas meter data, if FLOWCAL cannot apply a conversion factor to account for this, such as going from Dry to Partially Saturated, then the standard heating value will not be calculated and this exception will be generated.

To resolve exception 15212, set the Flowing Gas Condition field on the GPA 2172 tab in the Volume Editor to allow the GPA 2172 method to calculate the standard heating value or adjust the meter heating value saturation and/or source assignment to match the system heating value condition.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="15213">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />15213 Source apply not possible (missing sample pressure or temperature)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="15213">

This exception is generated if a sample density is selected for the liquid assignment option "Apply Density" and if either the sample pressure or sample temperature is not provided on the applied analysis. Both are required as well as the pressure gauge/absolute indicator and atmospheric pressure.

</div>

</div>
